title: Performance Signalboard: model & route overview canvas
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Design a compact, scannable ‘Performance Signalboard’ canvas that surfaces per-model and per-route runtime signals (latency percentiles, throughput, token metrics, cost per token) for devs and platform engineers. The canvas should work as a route-level default view and be embeddable in model pages and rollout screens.

Scope:
- Primary surface: single-row cards for routes/models with sparkline + trend + KPI badges.
- Expandable detail panel to show percentile charts (p50/p95/p99), tokens-per-call distribution, and request concurrency heatmap.
- Cost overlay that estimates per-1k tokens and per-1000-requests for the selected timeframe.
- Rollout annotations: highlight canary windows and automatic fallback events on timelines.
- Interaction patterns: hover tooltips, time-range zoom, selectable percentile lines, and quick copy of telemetry queries.

Out of scope for this ticket: in-console alerting workflow, RBAC control surfaces, and long-retention archival views (handled by Console Observability team).

Acceptance criteria:
- High-fidelity Figma prototype for desktop (1200–1600px) with responsive collapse behavior.
- Chart specs document that details data columns, downsampling, 1s/5s/1m aggregation windows and SLO shading rules.
- Annotated handoff page for frontend (components, CSS tokens, ARIA hints) and telemetry (recommended PromQL/SQL snippets).
- Sign-off from PM, Eng (runtime infra), and Research (metrics validation).

decisions: Primary card layout chosen: micro-cards (left) + compact sparkline (center) + KPI badges (right)
Percentiles surfaced by default: p50, p95, p99. p75 hidden behind toggle.
Downsampling policy: 1s raw when < 12h range, 5s for 12–72h, 1m for >72h.
Cost overlay will be an opt-in toggle stored in user preferences.
Rollout annotations will be fed from the Rollouts service (ENG-1987) and overlaid as vertical bands with label on hover.

charts_spec: Latency percentiles chart: lines for p50/p95/p99, tooltip includes sample count and error rate; SLO shading between p95 and threshold (configurable).
Throughput chart: stacked area showing requests/sec by model variant and route; supports breakdown toggle by plan (hosted/dedicated/private).
Tokens per call distribution: violin + median marker + 90th bucket shading; raw histogram buckets (0-32,33-128,129-512,513-2048,2049+) with sample counts.
Cost overlay: compute cost-per-1000-tokens using model profile metadata (model CPI) and runtime quantization factor; displayed as secondary axis and KPI badge.
Concurrency heatmap: minute-resolution grid showing hot windows by request concurrency; uses log color scale and supports clicking to drill into traces.
Rollout annotations: vertical bands with label and severity (info/warning/error) pulled from Rollouts service; clicking opens rollout timeline.
Data quality indicators: low-sample warning when sample count < 100 in range; stale-data marker when last datapoint > 10m ago.
Downsampling & aggregation rules: explicit policy strings and recommended query patterns included in handoff.
